comment: Proposed labels for test/ScoringCorpus/Pairs. better: after must score lower. worse: after must score higher. lateral: after must score exactly the same. tokensPerChar scores the pair with a fake token counter so the size rules price it. gap names the root cause a pair exposes while it still fails; see ScoringCorpusTests.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: Three named reads become one object-typed getter behind an enum with the arm bodies inline; same logic, less type information, callers still pick one of three.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: Same collapse with the arms delegating to private members; the case #78 closed.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: Same collapse with the selector enum named *Query, the name the dispatcher rule used to exempt.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: Thirty independent reads collapsed into one selector getter; width must not make the collapse pay.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: Three reads that each Load(id) and project merge into one read over a single Load; decided uncharged shared work.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: Three named writes become one Apply(action) with the bodies pasted into switch arms.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: An existing dispatcher's one-line private arm targets pasted into its arms; same logic, same door.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: One CC-50 method split into five CC-10 phases that share no locals.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: Five CC-10 phases inlined into one CC-50 method.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: Five private phases moved one each into five internal static classes; same code, more types.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A readable CC-11 loop shattered into five one-line helpers called once each.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: Three single-use one-line helpers merged into their only caller.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A helper with three callers pasted into each caller: three copies of the same logic.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: A duplicated validation block extracted into one helper used by both callers.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: A CC-3 helper with one caller inlined into its CC-3 caller; the code moves laterally, and one fewer method carries its own cost.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A dead call that discards its result is added so a helper looks reused.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: A public helper nothing outside the class needs becomes private.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A private helper becomes public surface.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A private helper becomes internal; cost order internal > private.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A private helper on an unsealed public class becomes protected; cost order protected > private.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: Two distinct publish operations merged into one method with a bool isPrivileged switch.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: A consumer in another assembly depends on a public interface over an internal implementation instead of on the public concrete class; the interface is the cross-assembly door.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: An interface added over a class whose only consumer is in the same assembly; nothing outside needs the door, so it is an unused abstraction.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: A cross-section consumer that only reads depends on a read interface instead of the full service, which another cross-section consumer still uses to write.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: A private static helper moved to an internal static class in the same file.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: A private helper with one caller becomes a static local function inside it.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: A class and its members renamed.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: Members reordered within the class.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: One class split into a partial class across two files.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: A file holding three classes of a section over 100k tokens split into one file per class; the section is priced on its whole files, so the split does not escape sectionSize.

pairs.label: better
pairs.rationale: A class past the 25k-token tax split into two sibling classes along a seam no method crosses; each piece now fits one read.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A shared test helper pasted into every test, so the section's tests outgrow its production code; the logic tested is unchanged.

pairs.label: lateral
pairs.rationale: An internal interface implemented explicitly instead of implicitly.

pairs.label: worse
pairs.rationale: A switch whose arms compute a price becomes a dictionary of lambdas keyed by the same enum; the table is one more declaration to read, so it pays one more flat charge.
